<!-- Generated by scripts/build.py: Claude hi-IN terminology -->
In hi-IN UI copy and responses, translate these terms exactly as listed:

- Claude Code → Claude Code. Product name. Keep in English in every language, without quotation marks.
- Cowork → Cowork. Product name. Keep in English.
- Remote Control → Remote Control. Keep in English when capitalized as the feature name. Translate lowercase “remote control” used descriptively.
- MCP / MCP server → MCP. Keep the abbreviation MCP; translate “server”.
- desktop app → डेस्कटॉप ऐप. Keep Claude Desktop and Claude Code for Desktop in English when used as names.
- Dispatch → Dispatch. Keep Dispatch in English as the feature name and on toggles. zh-Hans translates the verb as 派发.
- Session → सेशन. A unit of work in Claude Code and Cowork. zh-Hans: session = 会话, chat and conversation = 对话; never mix them.
- Chat / Conversation → चैट. zh-Hans uses 对话 for both chat and conversation, never 聊天. ja-JP and ko-KR: chat = チャット / 채팅, conversation = 会話 / 대화.
- Side Chat → साइड चैट
- Skill → स्किल. zh-Hans and zh-Hant keep Skill in English, never 技能. ja-JP uses the plural Skills.
- Artifact → आर्टिफ़ैक्ट. Handled differently per language: zh-Hans keeps Artifact, zh-Hant uses 成品, ja-JP keeps Artifacts, ko-KR transliterates as 아티팩트.
- Extension → एक्सटेंशन. Distinct from Plugin. zh-Hans: Extension = 扩展, Plugin = 插件; never use 插件 for Extension.
- Computer use → कंप्यूटर उपयोग. zh-Hans mostly uses 计算机使用: 21 against 2 for 电脑操作.
- Quick Entry → Quick Entry. Translated in menus and settings; some web strings still keep Quick Entry.
- Developer / Developer mode → डेवलपर मोड
- Project → प्रोजेक्ट
- Memory → मेमोरी. Claude’s memory feature. Hardware memory is a different word, e.g. zh-Hans 内存.
- Connector → कनेक्टर
- Plugin → प्लगइन. Distinct from Extension. zh-Hans: Plugin = 插件, Extension = 扩展.
- Message → मैसेज
- Incognito → इनकॉग्निटो
- Style → स्टाइल. zh-Hans: Claude’s response style = 风格, output style = 输出风格. Official copy uses 样式 for creating custom styles about half the time.
- Routine → रूटीन. zh-Hans mixes 例程 and 例行任务; 例程 is the majority.
- Scheduled task → शेड्यूल किया गया टास्क / शेड्यूल किए गए टास्क
- Integration → इंटीग्रेशन
- Voice mode → वॉइस मोड
- Knowledge (project knowledge) → ज्ञान
- Model → मॉडल. Never translate model names such as Opus, Sonnet and Haiku.
- Agent → एजेंट. zh-Hans: AI agent = 智能体, never 代理. 代理 is used only for system components such as the SSH agent.
- Research → रिसर्च
- Thinking / Extended thinking → सोच रहा है
- Prompt → प्रॉम्प्ट
- Context / Context window → संदर्भ
- Token → टोकन. As an LLM unit, keep lowercase token, e.g. zh-Hans “{count} 个 token”. Authentication tokens are translated, e.g. zh-Hans 令牌.
- Compact → कॉम्पैक्ट
- Tool → टूल
- Web search → वेब सर्च
- Plan mode → प्लान मोड
- Auto mode → ऑटो मोड
- Sandbox → सैंडबॉक्स
- Folder → फ़ोल्डर. ja-JP mixes フォルダ and フォルダー; フォルダ is the majority. Translate directory separately, e.g. zh-Hans 目录.
- Workspace → वर्कस्पेस
- Repository → रिपॉज़िटरी
- Worktree → वर्कट्री. The git worktree concept.
- Git origin → Git ऑरिजिन. Official translations are inconsistent; the recommendation follows the majority.
- Branch → ब्रांच
- Pull request → पुल रिक्वेस्ट
- Sign in / Log in → साइन इन. ja-JP keeps the distinction: sign in = サインイン, log in = ログイン.
- Organization / Admin → संगठन
- Credentials → क्रेडेंशियल
- Permission → अनुमति
- API key → API key
- Plan → प्लान. The subscription tier, such as Pro or Max. Distinct from plan mode, e.g. zh-Hans 套餐 versus 计划模式.
- Usage / Usage limits → उपयोग
- Upgrade → अपग्रेड
- Subscription → सदस्यता
- Seat → सीट
- Rate limit → रेट लिमिट
- Pin / Pinned → पिन. Pinning an item to the top of a list: zh-Hans 置顶, zh-Hant 釘選, ja-JP ピン留め. Locking a setting, such as a Git origin: zh-Hans 固定.
- Trust / Trusted → भरोसा. trusted folder = zh-Hans 受信任的文件夹.
- Allow / Allowed → अनुमति दें
- Approve / Approved → स्वीकृत करें
- Fork → फ़ोर्क
- Star / Starred → स्टार
- Archive → आर्काइव. An archive file format is a different term, e.g. zh-Hans 压缩文件.
- Share → शेयर. zh-Hans: 共享 for ongoing access, such as sharing a project or plugin; 分享 for sending content, such as sharing a chat or Skill.
- Attach / Attachment → अटैच
- this computer → कंप्यूटर. zh-Hans splits 计算机 and 电脑 almost evenly; 计算机 appears mostly with Computer use. Use 电脑 for the device.
- Phone → फ़ोन
- Cloud → क्लाउड. Keep names such as Google Cloud.
- Settings → सेटिंग्स
- Configuration / Config → कॉन्फ़िगरेशन. zh-Hans distinguishes settings = 设置 and config = 配置.
- Window → विंडो
- Terminal → टर्मिनल
- Connect / Connected / Connection → कनेक्ट
- Restart → रीस्टार्ट. ko-KR mostly uses 다시 시작, sometimes 재시작.
- Update → अपडेट. ja-JP uses 更新 in general and アップデート mainly for app version updates.
- Debug / Log → लॉग. zh-Hant mixes 偵錯 and 除錯; 偵錯 is the majority.
- Dictation → डिक्टेशन
